title: Your first KYC and AML calls

scenes.say: In this video, you'll send two calls from your own onboarding app: a full KYC identity check, and an AML screening that can also enrol the customer for ongoing monitoring.

show.card: Your first KYC and AML calls
show.subtitle: Sentinel by DeepTrack · Developer quick start

scenes.say: First, check your key's scopes. A KYC check needs Run KYC identity checks. An AML screening needs Run AML screenings, and the monitoring calls need Manage AML monitoring.
A KYC check is one call. You send the ID image, a liveness capture, and the customer's ID number, names, date of birth and gender.

show.subtitle: ID image + liveness capture + customer details

scenes.say: Encode each file as plain base64. Each one can be up to about 730 kilobytes. Send JPEG frames for liveness where you can, because face match compares the first frame with the ID photo.
Here is the request. A live key returns 202 with status queued. Keep the id. The result arrives by webhook, or you can fetch it later.

The verdict is pass, review or reject. Review means a step was unclear, and a case opens for your team. Because the API always takes a liveness capture, it's the only kind of KYC check that can be approved automatically.

show.scroll: case:Document, liveness, IPRS and AML all clear

show.highlight: case:Document, liveness, IPRS and AML all clear

scenes.say: Now an AML screening. Only the name and entity type are required. Add a date of birth or ID number when you have one, so you get fewer look-alikes to review.

show.subtitle: subjectName + entityType · add dateOfBirth and idNumber

scenes.say: Here, Wanjiku Kamau is screened against sanctions lists, PEP data, Kenyan risk lists and adverse media.

To keep watching a customer, set monitor to true and pass your own customer id as externalRef. Store the monitoring id you get back. Screen the same customer again and you get the same id, not a second subject.
When the screening completes, pass shows as Clear, review as Needs review, and reject as Match. The screening object explains the reason and lists every hit.
Subjects you enrol through the API appear under Monitored subjects on the AML Screening page. When the relationship ends, delete the subject through the API to stop monitoring.
That's KYC and AML from your own code. To learn more, open chapters C2 and C4 in Help.
